🔌 Connect a real AI video API free options

Keys stay on the server (server.js proxy). They are never exposed to the browser. If no key is set, the site runs in clearly-labeled Demo Mode and never fakes a video.

Option A · Replicate ⭐ recommended

  1. Create account at replicate.com (new accounts include free credit).
  2. Copy token from replicate.com/account/api-tokens.
  3. cp .env.example .env → set REPLICATE_API_TOKEN=…
  4. Restart: npm start. Model default minimax/video-01.

Option B · Hugging Face (free tier)

  1. Free token at huggingface.co/settings/tokens.
  2. Set HF_TOKEN=… and optionally HF_MODEL=cerspense/zeroscope_v2_576w.
  3. Restart server. Note: free Inference API can queue/warm-up.

Option C · Custom endpoint

  1. Set CUSTOM_VIDEO_API_URL (+ optional CUSTOM_VIDEO_API_KEY).
  2. Endpoint must accept {prompt, style, aspectRatio, duration, image?} and return {videoUrl}.
  3. Use for Runway / Luma / Stability gateways. Full spec in SETUP.md.
